core_luna_claim: The 9^k poly(n,L,eta^-1,log(1/delta)) relative approximation is valid; original code enumerates tiny diagnostic minors and is not the production polynomial coefficient algorithm.

stronger_claims.claim: Exact nonnegative sample X with E X=c and pointwise 0<=X<=C_k c, C_k=binom(2k,k).
stronger_claims.cost: O(C_k eta^-2 log(1/delta)) samples; each O(k n^3+k^2) exact field operations and polynomial bit height.

stronger_claims.claim: Every physical occupation prefix admits nonnegative Y with E Y=c_prefix and Y<=C_ab c_prefix, C_ab=binom(2k-a-b,k-a).
stronger_claims.cost: 2^b(2a+1) coefficient calls per sample; 2^b C_ab<=C_k; no inverse conditional probability or subtraction-accuracy cost.

stronger_claims.claim: Capped classical TV-epsilon Born sampler for the positive-norm promise.
stronger_claims.cost: O((k+1) C_k n^2 epsilon^-2 log(n/epsilon)) base coefficient evaluations after attributed Hellinger refinement, times polynomial-bit evaluation work.
stronger_claims.support_boundary: Rare charged all-zero-estimate fallback may have zero determinant weight; every classical output is a legal hard k-pair pattern.

stronger_claims.claim: Randomized uniform coherent preparation compiler with trace error <=epsilon and success probability >=1-delta over compiler seeds.
stronger_claims.cost: C_k poly(n,L,epsilon^-1,log(1/delta)) circuit size and compile work over one explicit fixed efficiently computable finite gate set.
stronger_claims.execution_status: MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION; no quantum synthesis or hardware execution
stronger_claims.gate_boundary: No Clifford+T optimization or runtime claim. Good compiler seed need not be efficiently recognized.

stronger_claims.claim: For any fixed A, k<=A log2(n+1) makes all these bounds polynomial.
stronger_claims.boundary: Generic k=Theta(n) remains exponential by these bounds.

zero_boundary: Every sample and estimate is exact zero when c=0; a zero estimate on a positive instance is possible within the confidence failure event and is not a deterministic zero certificate.
negative_evidence: For k independent swap blocks the raw site-sign sample is 4^k with probability 2^-k and zero otherwise, so relative second moment is 2^k. This is a route-specific estimator obstruction on an easy block count, not approximation hardness.
